full_prompt_en: A decorative gouache illustration shows a blond child playing a violin beside a dark woodland pond while two pale geese float in the water below. The child sits slightly left of center on a low rock, head lowered toward the instrument, wearing a cream shirt and muted brown-green overalls. The violin and bow are small warm brown shapes within a quiet pose. Tall blue-gray stems, broad leaves, layered shrubs, and rounded pale flowers frame the scene on all sides, making a dense botanical curtain around a near-black central opening. Mushroom-like caps appear on the right among the foliage. At the bottom, the pond is rendered as a deep black ribbon interrupted by a few gray-blue ripples and flat stones; the geese are creamy silhouettes with long curved necks. The palette is deliberately limited to inky navy, dusty teal, blue-gray, parchment cream, warm tan, and a little violin brown. Shapes are simplified and almost cut-paper flat, yet leaf veins and small strokes give them a fine printed texture. The pale child and geese make a descending rhythm of light areas against the dark center. Illumination is quiet and diffuse, with no visible bright lamp or hard shadows; contrast comes from light forms placed on dark ground. Upright stems at the sides stabilize the square composition, while curved leaves and the water band make it flow. The result feels hushed, intimate, and storybook-like, with repeated botanical shapes turning the entire setting into an ornamental frame.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅装饰性水粉插画呈现金发孩子在幽暗林中池边拉小提琴，两只浅色鹅在下方水里漂浮。孩子略偏左坐在低石上，低头朝向乐器，穿奶油色衬衫与低调棕绿色背带裤。小提琴与琴弓在安静姿态中成为小小暖棕形。高高的蓝灰茎、宽叶、叠层灌木与圆润浅花从四面框住场景，在近黑的中央开口外形成密集植物帘幕。右侧叶间还有蘑菇状伞盖。底部池塘是一条深黑色带，由少许灰蓝涟漪和平石打断；鹅是奶油色剪影，长脖弯曲。调色有意限制在墨蓝、灰青、蓝灰、羊皮纸奶油色、暖棕与少量小提琴褐色。形状简化且近乎剪纸般平面，但叶脉和细笔让它们有精致印刷纹理。浅色孩子与鹅在暗中心前形成自上而下的明亮节奏。照明安静漫射，没有可见亮灯或硬影；反差来自浅形落在暗底上。两侧直立茎稳定方形构图，弯叶与水带让它流动。结果低声、亲密、带绘本感，重复的植物形让整个环境成为装饰边框。
style_prompt_en: Decorative gouache illustration layers simplified matte shapes against an inky navy ground. Dusty teal and blue-gray occupy most of the patterned area, while parchment cream and warm tan form a descending chain of focal accents. Broad curved forms overlap closely around a nearly black central opening, and tall slender strokes at the sides lend the square composition a steady frame. Fine interior lines and faint grain add printed texture to otherwise flat color planes. A low dark horizontal band with a few cool reflections anchors the scene, while a small brown note warms the cool palette. Lighting is diffuse and subdued; pale shapes become luminous through placement against dark surroundings rather than glossy highlights or dramatic shading. Edges are crisp but gently hand-cut, with minor irregularities in wash density. Repetition of stems, arcs, and rounded pale clusters produces a calm ornamental rhythm. The result is intimate, hushed, and tactile, retaining a storybook simplicity even where the surface is densely patterned.
style_prompt_zh: 装饰性水粉插画把简化的哑光形状叠在墨蓝底上。灰青与蓝灰占纹样面积的大部，羊皮纸奶油色与暖棕组成一条下降的焦点强调链。宽阔弯形围绕近黑中央开口紧密叠压，两侧细长竖笔为方形构图提供稳定边框。细密内部线和淡颗粒给本来平面的色形增添印刷纹理。低位暗水平带和少量冷反光锚住场景，一点棕色暖意温柔打断冷调。照明漫射而低调；浅色形凭与暗周围的位置反差而发亮，不靠亮滑高光或戏剧明暗。边缘清晰却有轻微手剪感，罩染密度略不均。茎状竖线、弧线与圆润浅色簇的重复产生平静装饰节奏。结果亲密、低声且可触，即使表面纹样密集，仍保留绘本般的简单。
theme_en: A child playing violin by a moon-dark pond with white geese
theme_zh: 孩子在夜色池边拉琴，白鹅浮在水上
name: Abbey Lossing
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
